results.title: RealClimate: Unforced variations: Oct 2025
results.content: Climate science from climate scientists... 1 Oct 2025 by group. This month’s open thread. Lots of salient stuff this month so please try and stay focused and constructive! Even going as far as to **even** quote Dr Hansen! You really got it bad, don’t you? with regard to climate change. It should be noted that this testimony is the personal opinion of a private citizen. How in god’s name did you find that reference? Then we’ll talk about the proper context of 3 major very detailed very long peer reviewed papers he has published since then, which contrary to the disinformation by MAR +2, shows Hansen saying nothing of a kind, making no such a projection, or prediction nor what **he expects.**. It does not fit the standard to satisfy me in the context of what I was addressing here. For now I’ll stick to my comment Mo Yunus 30 Sep 2025 at 10:09 PM, in full.
